description: Predict multilingual LA leaderboard capability using model parameter scale and published evaluation cost fields.

contract.law_signature: law(input_data: list[dict[str, float]], group: str) -> list[dict[str, float]]

target_description: The response is the source-reported benchmark quantity identified by the `group` label; the law predicts one scalar metric within each group. Representative metric labels are acc norm,none, acc,none, average len,none, bleu,none, em,none, exact match,flexible-extract, and 10 more.
